headline: We tested Jev as a code reranker on 100 GitHub issues.
text:
We tested Jev as a code reranker on 100 GitHub issues. Model-planned grep + Jev was our best route, though the choice of retrieval route mattered more than the choice of reranker.

The benchmark is CodeNib Base: 25 repos across C/C++, Go, Python, Rust and TS/JS. The query is the…
